name: 26-heal-in-cerulean
objective: Walk across Cerulean City to its Pokemon Center and heal the party at the counter - the first heal on the far side of Mt Moon, and the thing that moves where blacking out puts you.
evidence: watch:last_blackout_map=0x03 - wLastBlackoutMap $D719, which the atlas records as 'where blacking out returns you - the last Pokemon Center you healed at'. It holds the TOWN and not the Center's interior map, which link 16 measured for Pewter: entering the building leaves the byte alone and talking to the nurse flips it. CERULEAN_CITY is const index 3. The same three conditions link 16 uses, for the same reasons: the flip proves the conversation began, party_missing_hp=0 proves it finished, and map=0x40 stops the goal firing anywhere but inside the building.

THIS LINK IS FIRST IN THE ARC BECAUSE OF WHERE A BLACKOUT PUTS YOU, not for tidiness. Until the nurse here has been spoken to the anchor is the Mt Moon Pokemon Center, whose door is on Route 4 at (11,5) - and Route 4's three doors are all on row 5 with x=19-23 solid on that row and x=20-23 solid on rows 6, 7 and 8, so the mountain's eastern mouth cannot be walked to from its western one. A blackout while training east of the mountain would therefore cost the whole crossing again. One conversation moves the anchor to this side of it.

map=0x40 is Cerulean's Pokemon Center: warp[2] of map 0x03 at (19,17) names it, and its own layout is the same building as Viridian's, Pewter's and Mt Moon's - 14x8, nurse at (3,1), doors at (3,7) and (4,7) - which is why one route table serves all four.

THE WALK IS ON ROW 19 AND NOT ROW 18, because the city's object list puts a walking NPC (movement $FE) at (15,18) and a Gen 1 sprite is solid. Row 19 runs clear from x=0 to x=22 with no object on it at all; twenty-one steps, breadth-first over the cartridge's own walkability grid.
A BLACKOUT IS A LEGAL DETOUR AND NOT A FAILURE, so party_hp=0 is not on the failure list - the same model links 20 to 25 carry. Here it costs nothing at all: the walk is one map.
